verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a bulk data export, an open-format export, or any offboarding or data-portability path. The trial page only says you can 'cancel and remove your data', which is deletion, not export. The bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets sync is a reporting workflow feature, not a documented way to export all of your data and leave, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
